items.title: INV-063 leg B DV DIRECTION diagnostic: which frozen-battery readout (701b MSE vs SD-056 InfoNCE) moves in the direction the claim asserts, and at what base convergence? Lever ON/OFF x converged/unconverged base.
items.note:
USER-COMMISSIONED, option B of the decision chip chip-20260919-inv063-legb-dv-direction (user answer 2026-09-19T09:25:51Z). Authoring of INV-063's four-arm intake-ladder falsifier was REFUSED at /queue-experiment Step 2.5a; the refusal, its measurements and the four options are staged at REE_assembly/evidence/planning/inv063_legb_dv_readability_staged_20260919.md (REE_assembly e66187df0a). This run is the cheap DV-DIRECTION diagnostic the user chose to run FIRST. The four-arm falsifier runs ONLY if this comes back green, and that go/no-go returns to the USER with these numbers; options C (re-point leg B's DV to InfoNCE) and D (convert INV-063 to substrate_conditional) stay open for that later decision and are /governance's, not this run's.

WHAT IT MEASURES. Lever use_sleep_world_forward_consolidation ON/OFF crossed with a CONVERGED vs UNCONVERGED base, 3 seeds = 12 cells. BOTH frozen-battery readouts are recorded across every sleep cycle on the SAME battery: 701b per-element MSE reconstruction error (the instrument INV-063 names by name) and the SD-056 InfoNCE contrastive loss the sleep trainer actually minimises. NO intake question is posed -- world_rule_shift is DISABLED in every arm. The two base regimes are matched on everything except the optimiser: identical P0 rollout, env, seed, action stream and buffering, with the Adam step withheld on the unconverged arms.

VERDICT SPLIT, deliberate. C1..C6 are VALIDITY criteria and are the ONLY things routing PASS/FAIL (plain AND): the converged arms converged (min conv_rel_drop > 0.90), the unconverged arms did not (max < 0.02), the lever moved the world heads on the ON arms (> 0), the OFF arms stayed bit-identical (<= 0) with the SAME MECH-423 pass running, the battery was populated (>= 32) with finite readouts, and sleep did work in every cell (min sws_n_writes and rem_n_rollouts > 0). D1..D4 are pre-registered DIRECTION findings carrying routes_verdict=false: they route NO PASS/FAIL and select interpretation.label. A NEGATIVE D IS A RESULT, NOT A FAILURE -- it is the measurement this run exists to make, and reading it as a FAIL is the confusion the split exists to prevent. Two distinct FAIL routes, both emitting no direction label: a per-cell readiness precondition unmet / a cell short of its cycles / a non-finite parameter -> substrate_not_ready_requeue; all cells ready but a C1..C6 failure -> legb_dv_direction_measurement_invalid.

GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4). Decisive readout: the across-sleep frozen-battery delta in BOTH readouts, crossed by lever and by base convergence. Checked v3_exq_1060_..._20260919T012511Z_v3 (2 arms, ONE base regime -- unconverged -- and the efficacy leg recorded UNGATED with no base contrast), v3_exq_1026_..._20260914T111100Z_v3 (E2.world_forward delta exactly 0.0, pre-build), v3_exq_798a_..._20260730T010651Z_v3 and v3_exq_701b/701c (frozen-probe P0 convergence, no sleep cycle at all). None crosses the lever with base convergence and none carries the InfoNCE readout past convergence -> NOT recoverable -> run.

DV-SYMMETRY, per arm. All four share one DV family: a SIGNED DIFFERENCE of two scalar readouts on a FIXED pre-captured battery, before vs after one sleep cycle. It is not an argmax/rank statistic (monotone-rescaling class cannot apply) and not a set-aggregate over interchangeable units (permutation class cannot apply). ARM_CONV_ON and ARM_FRESH_ON: the manipulation is a BINARY CODE-PATH GATE (whether a third loss closure and optimiser group exist at all), not a value transform of the DV, so no symmetry of the DV is invariant under it. ARM_CONV_OFF and ARM_FRESH_OFF: same gate, negative side; their DV is EXACTLY 0 by STRUCTURAL IDENTITY (world_forward depends only on the two world heads, no gradient reaches them, the same battery tensors are re-evaluated), which is the attribution CONTROL and must NOT be read as a measured null or used as a difference-in-differences baseline. The CONV-vs-FRESH contrast is a TRAINING-BUDGET difference in the base; MSE is a squared error and is invariant under no additive or multiplicative transform of the prediction, so the budget cannot cancel in it.

RED-TEAM (Step 4.5, fable 5.1, one pass): CONTESTED -- 6 findings, all disposed, 2 independently verified against LANDED data before acting. F1 ACKNOWLEDGED + INSTRUMENTED: a negative D1 on the converged arm is predicted by step-size arithmetic alone (cross_module_consolidation.py:155-162 builds a FRESH Adam per cycle, so 8 steps move each weight by at most 8*CMC_LR = 0.008 regardless of gradient -- V3-EXQ-1060's landed world-head delta 0.007899 is 98.7% of that bound), and this design does not separate it from the objective-mismatch explanation; not fixable without changing the arms the user fixed, so adam_step_bound_8x_lr, min_identity_predictor_mse and min_converged_battery_mse_after_p0 are recorded and competing_explanations_note says a reader must rule the step-size argument out first. F2 FIXED: the InfoNCE readout is pinned at its chance value ln(K) -- 1060's landed infonce_pre_on 4.15921 is ABOVE ln(64) = 4.15888, total movement 0.23% of ln(K) against MSE's 25% -- so D2/D4 now carry a pre-registered headroom non-degeneracy condition, scoped to mark ONLY those two unciteable without vacating D1/D3 or the run (the V3-EXQ-785 rule). F3 FIXED (reporting): 'InfoNCE is insensitive to a global scale/shift' is FALSE for this implementation (squared-L2-distance logits, e2_fast.py:359/:396-403); the sentence is not repeated and the correction is owed to /governance because V3-EXQ-1060's landed docstring asserts it. F4, F5, F6 FIXED (an over-claimed trajectory note, a missing identity-predictor reference for conv_rel_drop's denominator, and a docstring naming one FAIL route where the code has two).

SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP (Step 2.5c). No OPEN corrupting entry is on the DV path: the readouts are scoped to E2's two world heads and e2_fast.py carries zero ContextMemory references, so contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy does not reach them (V3-EXQ-1060's scoping, unchanged). DEGRADING overlaps noted for the record: SD-MECH267-CEM-SELECTION-FIX and mech203-valence-pool-admissibility both name hippocampal/module.py, which the waking phase exercises; neither routes a criterion here. e2-world-forward-sleep-trainer (degrading) is the lever's own entry and still reads status pending_implementation with its failure_record open despite the build landing and V3-EXQ-1060 passing -- raised as GFLAG-0359.

SCOPE. experiment_purpose diagnostic, evidence_direction non_contributory BY DESIGN: this adjudicates an INSTRUMENT and routes no verdict on INV-063. claim_id INV-063 is for traceability. Leg B is taken to be E2.world_forward throughout, per V3-EXQ-1060's documented chain; the claims.yaml E1 label correction is open as GFLAG-0355 and is /governance's.

items.title: MECH-537 communication-subspace routing, INSTRUMENT REPAIR: is the C2 orientation contrast distinguishable from the instrument's own noise, measured against a within-run permutation null and read at the parsimonious RRR rank?
items.note:
INSTRUMENT REPAIR of V3-EXQ-1043, not a new question. SUPERSEDES V3-EXQ-1043. AUTHORITY: the CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1043_2026-09-17.json (user Step 8 gate 2026-09-17T02:35Z), routing 'queue-experiment', recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action 'none', routing_detail.recommended_form verbatim 'ALPHABETIC SUFFIX (V3-EXQ-1043a) -- same scientific question, instrument repair. NOT a new EXQ number.'

WHY A REPAIR. V3-EXQ-1043 returned FAIL / routing_signature_incomplete_undetermined. All 7 readiness preconditions passed, the C1 phenotype was present (0.1717 vs a 0.05 floor) and the C5 single-subspace premise held (0.6357 vs 0.3699), so the run was NOT routed away to MECH-547 / MECH-555 -- it simply did not adjudicate. C2, the ONLY rank-matched contrast and the only one licensing an orientation reading, came in at 0.03196 against a hand-set 0.05 floor with 0 of 3 seeds clearing while staying POSITIVE on every seed ([0.03724, 0.04949, 0.00916]), so neither the confirming signature nor the dedicated rank-explains-it falsification was reached. C4b failed against an absolute 0.5 ceiling the driver itself records as the least externally-anchored threshold in the design. The autopsy's net: 'MIXED, MEASURES-dominant. Not chargeable to REE and not to MECH-537.'

THE FOUR CHANGES, all from routing_detail.required_changes. (R1) C2 is judged against a WITHIN-RUN PERMUTATION NULL instead of the hand-set floor: the RRR is refit on receiver rows shuffled WITHIN EPISODE GROUP and the per-seed statistic is a one-sided permutation p against alpha 0.05. Within-group is load-bearing -- _kfold_indices builds a GROUPED k-fold, so shuffling ACROSS episodes would pair a test episode's sender rows with a training episode's receiver rows, making a test row's target also literally a training target: the fit turns optimistic, the null inflates, and the test is biased AGAINST the claim in a way no reader could see from the manifest. The randrank comparator is held FIXED across replicates so the contrast is paired and the common term cancels. N_PERMUTATIONS 200 (min attainable p 1/201 = 0.00498). (R2) C2 is read at the PARSIMONIOUS rank -- smallest rank whose grouped-CV held-out R^2 is within 1e-3 of the ladder maximum -- because at rank = dy the RRR constraint is inactive, the fit IS unconstrained OLS, and the low-rank premise the biology supplies is not instantiated there at all. 1043 selected rank 32 = dy on 3/3 seeds off a flat asymptote. (R3) C4b's absolute ceiling is MEASURED IN-RUN, per seed, from that seed's own encoder. (R4) n raised 3 -> 6 with SEED_MAJORITY re-specified PROPORTIONALLY 2-of-3 -> 4-of-6 as a LOCAL constant; leaving the inherited 2 while raising n would turn 'a majority of seeds' into 'any 2 seeds', which the autopsy names as threshold-gaming dressed as a power fix.

R3 IN FULL, because it is the part with no precedent. required_changes[0] asks to 'ANCHOR C4b's ABSOLUTE 0.5 CEILING from a measured reference, the way the readiness anchors already are against V3-EXQ-1008'. THERE WAS NO SUCH REFERENCE TO IMPORT: v3_exq_1002 / 1008 / 1010 contain ZERO occurrences of sensitivity_ratio|dz_world|INSENSITIV, the only other evidence manifests carrying sensitivity_ratio (V3-EXQ-1000, 1006) measure unrelated statistics, and NOTHING measured anywhere in the corpus sat at or below 0.50 on this aimed probe (lowest ever observed 0.8318). The 0.50 had no demonstrated reachability at all. Raised as a decision chip rather than guessed; USER RATIFIED OPTION C 2026-09-19T00:49:12Z (measure the floor, keep the ceiling absolute above it) and RULE 1 2026-09-19T02:31:55Z (the map): ceiling(seed) = (F + I)/2, where F is the ratio measured through the rank-r subspace the encoder is MOST SENSITIVE TO (top-r eigenvectors of the state-averaged finite-difference J_std^T J_std, run through the IDENTICAL _decision_sensitivity machinery) and I is the NO-ROUTING reference from the FITTED decomposition's own component norms. Both endpoints are MEASURED in-run by the same machinery on the same encoder, so the rule introduces no new constant; it is fixed before execution and is not tunable after seeing data. Per seed, not pooled -- the RULE is fixed, the realised value moves because the encoder moves, exactly as C5 already scores against a MEASURED per-seed chance level.

WHICH RANK THE SCORED CRITERIA READ -- a design call made in the build, recorded so it can be contested. The autopsy names only C2. But C4b splits each oracle decision coordinate BY the subspace C2 is computed on, and C5 asks whether THAT subspace is stable, so scoring C2 at one rank and C4b/C5 at another would make the confirming conjunction a statement about two different subspaces -- a defect, not an alternative. The whole SCORED set therefore reads the parsimonious rank; the CV-selected-rank configuration (1043's exact one) is computed and RECORDED in full alongside, so the comparison stays direct. ROAD NOT TAKEN: leave C1/C3/C4/C5 at the CV-selected rank.

STATED LIMITATIONS. (a) THE C4b ANCHOR MAY NOT BE REACHABLE, and the run is queued knowing it. measured and I share a decomposition (clean, retention-matched) but F does not, so F mixes the sensitivity factor the Jacobian alignment minimises with an uncontrolled geometry factor ||b_jac||/||a_jac||. The --dry-run smoke hit that at its degenerate rank 1 (80 rows, ladder row-capped): measured 4.4625, F 4.4526, I 4.3328, all within 3% -- geometry dominated, sensitivity factor ~1.0, ceiling NaN. Rank 1 settles nothing about ranks 8-10. THE FAILURE MODE IS SAFE: _c4b_ceiling returns NaN when F is not strictly below I, the seed is scored UNREACHABLE and EXCLUDED rather than failed, and a seed majority unreachable makes C4b unscoreable and routes to undetermined while still REPORTING F and I per seed -- which is itself the measurement required_changes[0] asked for, and strictly more than 1043 knew. It cannot produce a false verdict. A mid-scale probe to settle F vs I in advance is preserved at REE_assembly evidence/planning/v3_exq_1043a_mech537_design_staged_20260918.md sec A7; it did not complete in the dispatching session (ree-cloud-4 is a dispatch box, not an experiment worker). (b) SD-106: the encoder under test carries it and the lineage ran with p0a_field_weight_on = 0.0. It is an OPEN substrate_queue entry but its severity is 'degrading', not 'corrupting', so the Step 2.5c gate does not block; the autopsy files it as a known limitation on the measurement path, not a new defect. This is why source_adequacy_ws250_full is a PRECONDITION (1043 measured 0.9335 vs a 0.80 floor), not an assumption. (c) EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE stays 'diagnostic'. The autopsy's debt class is 'complex (probe-gated) / puzzle (known rules) ... what is missing is a FACT ... That is a spike'; promoting the contract to 'evidence' is a scope change it did not authorise, so this run routes and does not verdict the claim. (d) No criterion asserts an exact committed ACTION -- torch.multinomial diverges across machine classes, so every criterion stays upstream of the discrete quantizer (decode agreement and encoder sensitivity), as in 1043.

HONEST EXPECTATION, carried verbatim from the autopsy rather than hedged: 'at adequate n the likely outcome is a confidence interval EXCLUDING 0.05 -- i.e. H1 falsified rather than rescued. Raise n to settle the question, not to pass it.'

NOT A LIT-PULL: secondary_routing 'none'; targeted_review_mutual_legibility_communication_subspaces already carries Semedo2019 / Binish2026 / Gonzalez2026. C4a is NOT promoted to the scored conjunct (autopsy-forbidden, retention-confounded); the RRR ladder is NOT extended (mathematically impossible, rank <= dy = 32 and it already spans 1..32).

GATES: --self-test 45/45 PASS (including a replay of the parsimonious-rank rule over V3-EXQ-1043's LANDED rrr_heldout_r2_by_rank that must return the autopsy's stated 8, and a pin that SEED_MAJORITY differs from the inherited x1002 value); validate_experiments --strict OK, 0 findings of any class; --dry-run smoke rc=0 exercising every new path. Driver landed at ree-v3 e34e2148 on origin/main.

STEP 4.5 RED-TEAM RECORD (cross-model, fable; this session is Opus 5). VERDICT: CONTESTED -- 3 verdict-moving findings, 6 hygiene, 11 cleared checks. ALL THREE ACCEPTED AND APPLIED before queueing; driver ree-v3 1df36832 on origin/main.
M1, and it was a real bug and the worst failure mode available: the scored C2 did not test its own definition. c2_obs = R - C and every c2_null[b] = R - C_b carry the SAME fixed R = D_randrank, so R cancels and the permutation p is exactly P(D_comm_perm <= D_comm), blind to the SIGN of D_randrank - D_comm. A seed set with D_comm ABOVE D_randrank on every seed -- the claim's own FALSIFYING direction -- could have satisfied C2 and printed 'communication_subspace_routing_failure_confirmed', whose text asserts the opposite of the measured sign, while _c2_falsified (which does read the sign) was blocked by `not c2`: confirm and falsify were reading different contrasts. FIXED: C2 is now a conjunction of (seed majority with p <= alpha) AND (seed majority with D_randrank - D_comm > 0). This RESTORES the autopsy's definition rather than adding a criterion -- the autopsy changed C2's REFERENCE, not its DEFINITION.
M2, accepted as a RECORDING fix; the ratified RULE is NOT altered. Because the probe perturbs by UN-NORMALISED components, measured = (b/a) x (S_out/S_in) and I = (b/a), so 'measured <= (F+I)/2' is exactly 'S_out/S_in <= (F/I + 1)/2'. The rule therefore constrains the PER-UNIT ratio, and its effective bar RISES toward 1.0 as F approaches I -- i.e. the criterion gets weaker the less the encoder's most-sensitive rank-r subspace concentrates its response, and at F -> I a PASS means only 'no more coupled than isotropy predicts'. THIS IS A REAL WEAKNESS OF THE RATIFIED RULE AND IT IS BEING RUN ANYWAY, knowingly: the per-seed per-unit ratio, the effective per-unit bar and the anchor headroom fraction (I-F)/I are now RECORDED per seed, so an autopsy can see exactly how much headroom each seed's ceiling had rather than deriving it. The red-team's further suggestion -- a pre-registered minimum headroom floor so 'reachable' cannot be met by finite-difference noise -- WAS NOT APPLIED: it would change a user-ratified pass criterion, which is not this session's call. OWED to governance / a successor autopsy.
M3, a WRONG justification withdrawn rather than quietly edited: the within-group shuffle was justified by a train/test LEAK through the grouped k-fold. There is no such leak on this path -- the basis comes from full_fit on ALL train rows and the decoder is scored on te_eps, episodes that never enter any RRR -- so no fold boundary is load-bearing for anything scored. The REAL property is that within-episode shuffling leaves the BETWEEN-episode covariance exactly intact, which is the conservative choice for this question (MECH-537's signal lives in the timestep-level correspondence, which is what the shuffle destroys) but changes H0. Added a cheap between-episode reference -- the same estimator fitted on EPISODE MEANS only, one extra fit per seed -- so the null's episode-level share is visible in the manifest. Diagnostic, never scored.
HYGIENE ACCEPTED AS NOTED, NOT FIXED (each would change scoring or cost, and none blocks): H1 C2's `measured` is the mean p while `passed` is a seed-majority conjunction, so a naive recompute of measured<=threshold can disagree with `passed` -- the per-seed p's and both seed counts are recorded, so the conjunction is auditable. H2 the randrank_control_supra_trivial readiness anchor is a rank-32 reference now evaluated on a rank-8-10 arm, and it fires only after all 6 seeds -- a red gate would cost the whole run; early-abort after seed 1 is the suggested fix and is OWED. H3 nothing in this call path seeds the global torch RNG, so seeds 42/43/44 are NOT replays of V3-EXQ-1043's encoders; this is a lineage-wide property, not introduced here, but it means 'directly comparable to 1043' should be read as same-protocol, not same-encoder. H4 estimated_minutes 660 assumes a null replicate costs <= ~15 s; at ~30 s it is 14 h+. H5 a comment overstates 'excluded from the denominator' -- unreachable seeds cannot COUNT toward the required 4, which is conservative. H6 the red-team could not read the dry-run manifest on its box.
CLEARED BY THE RED-TEAM, among others: the n=6 / SEED_MAJORITY=4 proportional re-specification; the +1-corrected one-sided permutation p; _permute_within_groups being a true within-group permutation with fold structure and centring identical to the observed fit; the parsimonious-rank rule being a pre-registered rule over CV output that reproduces 8/10/10 on the landed 1043 ladders and is NOT circular; scoring every criterion at one rank as coherent; the Jacobian-aligned basis being built in the same standardised coordinates the decision probe splits in; no threshold derived from this run's own data; and the criteria mapping onto MECH-537's registered CONFIRMING / FALSIFYING wording.
